# Markdown corpus ## 1 Headings # H1 heading ## H2 heading ### H3 heading #### H4 heading ##### H5 heading ###### H6 heading Setext H1 ========= Setext H2 --------- ## Closing hashes ## ## Glued hashes stay## #NotAHeading is a tag ## Week #3 ## **Squat** day ## ## Foo # ##  ## No-break-space lead stays prose ## 2 Emphasis **bold** and __bold__ *italic* and _italic_ ***bold italic*** and ___both___ **bold with *nested italic* inside** *italic with **nested bold** inside* ~~strike~~ and ==highlight== and **==both==** snake_case_word, 2*3*4 and intra*word*emph „_foarte greu_“ and —_x_ and «_y_» italicise, ș_a_ and über_x_ stay literal Squat 3*10, Bench 3*8 stays literal `inline code` and ``code with ` backtick`` and `*not emphasis*` **unclosed bold and *unclosed italic \*escaped\* \_escaped\_ \#not-a-tag \[not a link\] back\\slash HTML & entities © and html tag and a
break Numeric © — decode; unknown &nope; and `&` in code stay as typed Invisible   ‮ – and wide 😀 stay as typed, no tag %%comment%% and $x^2$ math and $$block math$$ ## 3 Links [text](https://example.com) and [title](https://example.com "with title") [parens](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foo_(bar)) and https://bare.example/path?q=1. End of sentence (https://in.parens.example). ![image alt](https://example.com/img.png) and ![[embedded.png]] ![indented image](https://example.com/img.png) [[Session 1]] and [[Session 1|alias]] and [[Session 1#heading]] [angle dest]() and and and a literal https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Squat_(exercise) and (see https://example.com/a_(b)). [[Front matter|the front matter note]] and [[Front matter#Body after front matter]] and [[Front matter.md]] and [[Front matter^block]] [[#4 Lists]] jumps within this note and ![[Front matter]] embeds and [[a|b|c]] stays literal mid-line ![alt with **bold**](https://example.com/i.png "Title") image ![](https://example.com/empty-alt.png) has an empty alt and [Guide](https://example.com 'Bob's guide') opens no title and [t](https://example.com "say \"hi\"") escapes its quotes [[#Week #3]] lands on a heading that holds a hash and [[#Squat day]] on one shown without its markup [ref link][1] and footnote[^1] and mailto:me@example.com [1]: https://example.com [^1]: The footnote text. ## 4 Lists - bullet * star bullet + plus bullet - nested two spaces - nested four - tab nested - [ ] open task - [x] done task - [X] capital done - [-] cancelled task 1. first 2. second 1) paren style 3. restart numbering 10. ten - loose item paragraph inside loose item - item with continuation line - Paragraph right after the list - list right after a paragraph ## 5 Quotes and callouts > quote line > > nested quote > - list in quote > lazy continuation > [!TIP] Tip title > body of tip > [!WARNING] > warning body > [!custom] unknown type > [!NOTE]- folded callout > hidden body Paragraph right after a callout ## 6 Code ```dart void main() { print('hi'); } // - not a list # not a heading ## build ## ``` ~~~ tilde fence ~~~ indented code block (4 spaces) ## 7 Tables and rules | Col A | Col B | |-------|------:| | a | 1 | | **b** | `c` | | [[Session 1|legs]] | the alias shows inside one cell | | a \| b | an escaped pipe stays in its cell | | indented | row | | [[Bench|`PR`]] | | [[Squat\|legs]] | Obsidian's escaped alias shows raw, no link | | a | b \| Col A | Col B --- | --- no | pipes --- *** ___ - - - * * * _ _ _ - -- -  - - - ---- ## 8 Breaks and misc line with two trailing spaces next line line with backslash\ next line see https://bare.example/x\ the url keeps its backslash escaped backslash stays\\ \ Hard wrapped paragraph #tag #multi-word #nested/tag #123 #tag-with-dash #ünïcode #program/5x5 #5x5 #1rm #531a and a trailing #gym/ slash {{ghost placeholder}} and {red:colored text} and ==yellow:colored highlight== $- 12.50 coffee $- 3 tea keeps its backslash\ $$ balance ## 9 Unclosed fence (last on purpose) ```unclosed everything after this is code in Obsidian still code
